_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco collaboration endpoints, 14 Sep 2026: Webex Room / Board / Desk devices, cameras, microphones, legacy TelePresence, IP phones, headsets. The series ROLE is the phone deploy_role the cup engine reads (deployRole.ts, axis phone — unified-communications phones read this table too); each role reproduces the III.0 SKU rules (7920-7926 / 8821 / 840 / 860 / 9821 / SLINK wireless; 7832 / 7935-7937 / 8831 / 8832 / Room Phone conference; 6823 / 6825 / SPA302D dect; the rest desk). Headsets and Desk devices come before the IP-phone shared-parts rule because their SKUs also start CP-.

series.note: layers round 3, collaboration round: CTS-1700-PR-K9 'MXP 1700 Promotion' and CTS-INTP6000-WP-K9 'IntPkg 6000 MXP - PAL, Encrypted, BW, PrecisionHD Cam, Mic', the legacy TelePresence MXP systems named by their rows, sat in the line's shared parts (a video device and a codec in shared parts)

^AVIZ-CA(300|750) (layers round 3, collaboration-endpoints round): the Avizia CA300 / CA750 clinical carts and their cabinets, trays and cords (SolutionsPlus), labelled TelePresence MX Series by the generic collaboration end-of-sale notice. The label check kept them in TelePresence MX on the cart's own model number — CA300 read as the MX300 token, CA750 as a 7xx model of MX700 — which names no MX; with AVIZ-EDU=, AVIZ-SYN= and AVIZ-TAC-K9 they are Avizia products no document ties to one system. AVIZ-MXCART= 'Avizia MX Cart' names MX and stays there. — decision pending: CTS-LAPT-DISP / CTS-LAPT-DISP= 'TelePresence Laptop Display' and CTS-VX-EDUCATOR-K9 'VX Educator package' are whole products (kinds display / video-device) that no document ties to a TelePresence series — only the generic 'HW Collaboration PIDs' / 'Collaboration PIDs' end-of-sale notices name them, under the TelePresence MX Series label, and the catalogue holds no other VX row. Kept here (recommendation) until a series is named (layers round 3, collaboration-endpoints round)

^SPA3 fenced (layers round 3, collaboration-endpoints round): SPA302D is the Multi-Line DECT handset, filed in unified-communications beside its SPA232D base. The empty 'SPA302D DECT handset' series that used to sit here only to give those rows a dect role is removed; with the fence, deployRole finds no role-bearing series for SPA302D here and its own ph.dect rule gives dect

^PA100- (layers round 3, collaboration-endpoints round): the PA100 5V / 2A supply in five plug variants. Four names say 'Power supply for SPA500, CP500, and SPA 900 Series' and the label check kept them here; PA100-AS says only 'Linksys VoIP Products' and was moved to IP Phones shared parts, splitting one supply across two series by the wording of one plug variant

^CIUS-BATTERY (layers round 3, servers round): CIUS-BATTERY=, the Cius tablet endpoint's battery planned in from servers-unified-computing; the catalogue holds no Cius endpoint to give it a series. ^MB100$ (collaboration-endpoints round): 'Wall-mount brackets for SPA 300, SPA 500, CP 500, and SPA 900 Series' names two series of this line and two outside it; the label check kept it in SPA300 IP Phones because a sibling's three-digit token (500) is too weak to contradict a label, but a part named for several series is what the line's shared parts hold

lines.no_family_reason: Cisco names each IP phone series (3900, 6800, 6900, 7800, 7900, 8800, 9800, the wireless and DECT phones, SPA300 / SPA500) directly under Cisco IP Phones; the deploy role, not a family, groups them

series.note: ^SPVAC-(C7416|H5610|UC725) (layers round 3, collaboration-endpoints round): the nine SolutionsPlus accessory PIDs listed by Cisco's 'Virtualization Experience Media Engine Accessories Data Sheet' (c78-702849, under collaboration-endpoints/virtualization-experience-media-engine); their names are bare placeholders ('Cisco <PID>'), so the label check could not read a series token and moved them to the line's shared parts, leaving the series empty. The other SPVAC- rows (SPVAC-H450, a Jabra handset for TelePresence MX) are not on that sheet and are not matched
